face_reason: Actual face is longer and narrower than Regigigas with more extended chin, lower longer nose, small narrow eye and wider mouth. Palkia has a high ponytail and more tapered shorter jaw, Heatran has a stronger angular cheek/eye shape, Vivillon a smaller soft jaw and larger eye. Canonical Giratina one-eye bangs and crown braid preserved; structure compared separately from hair and horns.
diversity_comparison: Viewed recent actual WebPs and own originals. Roller rink diagonal glide/crop shorts, workshop reclined seated/shirt trousers, parade marching/cropped jacket mini skirt differ in place, activity, silhouette and body angle. Regigigas fan/backstage, lifeguard seated float and checkerboard mod dance also use different combinations; Palkia cafe, parcel and painting, Heatran reading/afterparty/volleyball, Vivillon pool/cafe/bike differ.
